items.title: In Defence of Vent Posting
items.summary: Drawing on my decade of experience as a 7cups Listener and research on emotional sharing, I argue in defense of vent posting. Community support and empathy are essential medicine, and we should meet people where they are rather than moralizing their coping mechanisms.
